category_title: Hospitalized youth with mental disorders exhibiting radical mood swings and behavioral instability
scenario_title: Matriculation Exam Preparation and Mood Swings
minimal_context: The student is sitting with a tutor at Ziv School to prepare for an upcoming Matriculation Exam.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's continue preparing for your upcoming Matriculation Exam. We need to go over the practice questions we started yesterday.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't want to look at it. My inner world is just too stormy and complicated today.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Try to focus on the first page. What do you think the answer to the first question is?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I can't focus! My mood keeps swinging and I just feel really bad right now.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We have put a lot of effort into preparing you for this exam. Just keep trying.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't care about the effort! I'm in a terrible mood and I've decided I'm not going to take the exam at all.

task.learning_goal: Get its students to succeed in their studies

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Suddenly arrive in a bad mood

behavior_patterns.internal_state: Inner world is stormy or complicated
